context_for_next_testing_agent: Major refactor testing completed successfully. Key changes verified: 1) Pricing Config module removed - costs now come from inventory items. 2) Inventory uses warehouse hierarchy (Zone/Aisle/Shelf/Rack/Bin) instead of location_code. 3) Location uses What3Words text input instead of lat/lng. 4) Project creation uses inventory dropdowns + manual costs. 5) Light theme sidebar (white background). 6) PDF download works on approved projects. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_refactor_features.py covers all API changes.
